raw_blocks: About SBC Medical Group Holdings
Japan's leading medical platform, supporting 250+ medical institutions in Japan and abroad.
Creating an environment where medical institutions can focus on care

As a Medical Services Organization (MSO), SBC Medical Group Holdings Incorporated provides wide-ranging support for the growth of medical institutions, spanning management strategy, marketing, DX, and talent development. Our clinic network reaches more than 250 locations in Japan and overseas, and in 2024 we listed on NASDAQ. We continue to move toward our goal of becoming the most chosen medical group in the world.

raw_blocks: About SBC Medical Group Holdings

SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. provides comprehensive management support to clinics across a wide range of medical fields, including aesthetic medicine, dermatology,dentistry, hair loss treatment, fertility treatment, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and regenerative medicine. Through an extensive network of clinics both in Japan and abroad, we are committed to delivering high-quality medical services while supporting the sustainable growth of healthcare institutions.

pages.raw_title: SBC Medical Group Holdings Inc｜Board Members
pages.raw_meta: A message from our CEO—our vision for the future and our commitment to customers and society.
raw_blocks: About SBC Medical Group Holdings
Illuminating the Heart Through the Power of Medicine.
CEO, SBC Medical Group Holdings

25 years after opening our clinic Fujisawa city, we remain captivated by the limitless possibilities of aesthetic medicine. When we began, many people were interested in aesthetic medicine but found it difficult to get started. However, as times have changed, more and more people now visit our clinic with the pure desire to "live authentically and positively". Aesthetic medicine is no longer something special or out of reach. Instead, it has become one of the choices that enriches our daily lives. SBC Medical Group is proud to have helped shape this perspective across society. Building on the expertise we have cultivated in medical services, we are expanding our knowledge and offerings beyond aesthetic medicine. By incorporating general medical care, we aim to contribute to even more people’s well-being. In 2024, we became a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ in the United States. This milestone represents a significant step forward in our commitment to earning and maintaining the trust of our valued customers. At SBC Medical Group, our goal is not simply to pursue profit but to achieve what we call the "Ultimate Win-Win for All". First, we strive to bring smiles to our customers, helping them embrace each day with confidence and positivity. Second, we aim to create an environment where our staff can take pride in their work, continuously grow, and find fulfillment in their careers. Finally, we seek to contribute to society by leveraging the power of medicine to create new value and drive sustainable progress. Moving forward, we will continue to take on new challenges to bring light to as many hearts as possible through the power of medicine. We sincerely appreciate your continued support and trust in our mission.
